controls.leastPrivilege: Role guards plus service-level ownership predicates; PostgreSQL is not exposed publicly.
controls.export: Authenticated scoped APIs and audited bounded XLSX administrative export; no unauthenticated bulk export.
controls.backup: Encrypted age backups, guarded restore target, weekly restore validation, and restricted deployment access.
controls.evidence: Correlation-linked minimized audit records and immutable financial/contract transition records.
controls.deletion: Operational archive/supersede controls exist; irreversible erasure and legal-hold schedules remain disabled until policy approval.

collections.name: identity-security
collections.purpose: Account authentication, onboarding, session security, and administrator access control.
collections.access: Self/session owner and restricted identity administrators; secrets and OTP material are never returned or audited.
collections.deletion: Session revocation and account disable/archive are enforced; final anonymization schedule is policy-blocked.

collections.name: family-and-child-service
collections.purpose: Eligibility, safe pickup/drop-off, emergency contact, school assignment, and account capacity.
collections.access: Owning family and role-restricted administrators with uniform not-found ownership enforcement.
collections.deletion: Student/archive and address activation controls prevent operational use; final child-record erasure is policy-blocked.

collections.name: enrollment-pricing-contract
collections.purpose: Service enrollment review, price acceptance, and immutable contract evidence.
collections.access: Owning family and enrollment/contract administrators; bounded histories and audited exports.
collections.deletion: Cancellation limits active processing; immutable accepted evidence awaits approved statutory schedule.

collections.name: payments-and-receipts
collections.purpose: Payment scheduling, receipt review, exact-once financial finalization, disputes, and reconciliation.
collections.access: Owner/admin IDOR checks; private short-lived object URLs; immutable transaction rows; audit values exclude references.
collections.deletion: Raw evidence is deleted after canonicalization; accepted/rejected/disputed canonical cleanup is policy-blocked.

collections.name: student-photos
collections.access: Owning family and photo-review administrators through short-lived private URLs; approved-only downstream state.
collections.deletion: Raw/failed/superseded cleanup is enforced; archived/current approved retention awaits policy and card template.

collections.name: notifications-and-consent
collections.purpose: Required service notices, optional consented updates, delivery, read state, and retry evidence.
collections.access: Owner-scoped notification APIs and restricted operational administration; message bodies excluded from logs.
collections.deletion: Operational admin history is bounded to 30 days; final consent/outbox deletion schedule awaits approval.

collections.name: broadcasts
collections.access: Restricted broadcast administrators; test sends and lifecycle changes are audited; recipient lists are bounded.
collections.deletion: Cancellation stops delivery; recipient evidence cleanup awaits approved campaign/legal schedule.

collections.name: feedback
collections.purpose: Support, safety escalation, response, and service improvement.
collections.access: Submitter-scoped history and restricted administrator queue; response content is excluded from audit snapshots.
collections.deletion: Closure is enforced; erasure/anonymization schedule and safety/legal holds await approval.

collections.name: audit-evidence
collections.purpose: Security, accountability, dispute evidence, and incident investigation.
collections.access: Restricted entity-scoped administrators; strict value allowlist and sensitive-field redaction.
collections.deletion: No product deletion endpoint; retention and legal-hold schedule awaits approval.
